info.description: Public type-specific FAQ and Skill authoring, publication, and exact-version API.

post.description: Resolves bounded entry references to compact management state. Results preserve input order and report misses explicitly. Each item is authoritative when read, but the batch is not a global snapshot.

post.description: Deletes the requested FAQ families sequentially. Each family deletion is atomic, but the batch is not: a family that cannot be deleted is reported in errors and the others are still processed, and deletions completed before a request-level error remain applied. Retrying the same request is safe because already absent entries are ignored.

delete.description: Withdraws the FAQ publication without changing version content. An already-unpublished entry is a no-op. Concurrent publication changes are last-write-wins in Playbook v1.

put.description: Publishes the selected immutable FAQ version. Repeating the currently published version is a no-op. Concurrent publication changes are last-write-wins in Playbook v1.

post.description: Submit an FAQ for human review. Extraction and agent submissions share proposalPolicy.maxOpenProposals. When the Inbox is full, HTTP 409 content-limit-exceeded identifies the configured limit and observed open count; the proposal was not saved. Review/dismiss existing proposals or ask an administrator to increase the configured limit before retrying. Capacity is advisory because Search is eventually consistent.

Promotes the reviewed revision to one canonical unpublished FAQ.
Concurrent calls and retries resume or return the proposal's recorded target.
A complete target may be visible to management before the proposal reaches
promoted, but remains absent from serving until separately published.

get.description: Returns exact candidate file bytes for the requested proposal revision. A stale revision returns HTTP 412 /errors/revision-conflict; responses must not be cached.

parameters.name: expectedRevision
parameters.description:
Resource revision. Opaque: each change to a resource's own configuration writes a
new value, and a resource never gets a value it had before. Compare for equality
only; its format is the service's, so only its length is constrained. Returned as
`revision`; sent back as `expectedRevision` to make a write conditional. Omitting
`expectedRevision` makes the write unconditional.

get.description:
Returns independent best-effort indexed observations using content-read permissions.
Indexing delay, expiry and concurrent writes can make counts differ from list results
or prevent publication buckets from summing to the total. This is not an atomic
snapshot or a receipt of entries deleted by clear or bulk delete.

limit.description: Optional request cap, still bounded by the Playbook discovery maxResults policy.

truncated.description: True when eligible fetched candidates exceed the result slots left by pins, independently of token admission. This count signal is bounded to the fetched candidates, not the entire index.

budgetTruncated.description: True when the token budget skips an eligible fetched entry while filling result slots. Later fetched candidates may fill those slots if they fit; admission stops at the result count limit or the end of the fetched candidates. Empty results with this flag do not mean no knowledge matched. Omitted means false; independent of count-based truncated.

new value, and a resource never gets a value it had before. Compare for equality
only; its format is the service's, so only its length is constrained. Returned as
`revision`; sent back as `expectedRevision` to make a write conditional. Omitting
`expectedRevision` makes the write unconditional.

also refresh inbox/purge deadlines.

(`minScore`) points the same way: higher is stricter.

smaller SkillPreviewContent, also used by StableEntry publications. Version responses use this complete shape.
